products.summary: Belkin UltraGlass 2 for iPhone 16 Plus and 15 Plus: 0.29 mm double ion-exchanged LAS glass, up to 2.7x stronger than tempered glass protectors.
products.description: Belkin UltraGlass 2 is lithium aluminosilicate (LAS) glass chemically toughened by double ion-exchange, just 0.29 mm thin, with full-screen coverage and an Easy Align tray for bubble-free application at home. Belkin rates it up to 2.7x stronger than tempered glass protectors with up to 24% better drop performance than the previous UltraGlass.
